inputIdentity.timestampBasis: mtime of original full inventory immediately after collection; installed environment is mutable, not an immutable runtime archive

sourceTar.scope: Earlier source worktree tar, not a P05 split-package artifact; hash measured after inventory and agrees with saved build-evidence SHA.

babeldocDerivedWheel.scope: Selected installed native/metadata/license bytes checked against wheel; not verification of all runtime distributions or final archive.

mineruModels.scope: Revision recorded by existing download manifest; model payload hashes not recomputed in this audit.

limitations: Installed files are not final runtime archives.
RECORD ownership is declarative, not upstream byte verification.
Metadata license labels and upstream homepages do not establish corresponding source or redistribution clearance.
Committed compact snapshot keeps native/model/font paths and per-distribution file counts; full code/data lists are reproducible via the script.
